name: Broken Heart
summary: Red heart split by a zigzag crack with the halves drifting apart: use for heartbreak, breakups or sadness.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 490 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: heart colour; a darker edge is added

params.name: anim
params.note: split = halves drift apart and back, shake = trembling

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames
